The tree is also associated with several Gods and Goddesses, including Lord Vishnu, Goddess Lakshmi, and Lord Krishna.

historical_references.reference: In Hindu mythology, Champak is a name given to the flowering tree 'Cassia fistula'. The tree is believed to have appeared when the gods Parvati and Shiva were in deep meditation. Champak is also known as the 'Golden Shower Tree'.
Champak is also a name given to the goddess Sita in the Hindu epic 'Ramayana'. She was found as a baby in a Champak tree and was named after the tree by her foster-mother, Renuka.
